name: The Scorchfarer
source:
The story of The Scorchfarer is set on a post-apocalyptic high fantasy world. A cosmic event known as the 'fire rain' destroyed most life on the surface of the planet. It was soon discovered that the flames were so magically dense that it would take a millenia for them to die on their own. Both of the continents, Uzu and Zuhaar, joined forces to bring back balance to their world. A new breed of magus was born, the Terramagus, tasked with healing the world and to give every living creature hope for the future.

Mikaela and Yukiharu, two novice Terramagi are about to set off into the heart of the continent after finishing their training. Their journey is about to become much more complicated than they could ever imagine as the secrets of their world slowly unravel.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《The Scorchfarer》的故事背景设定在一个后世界末日的奇幻世界。一场被称为“火雨”的宇宙事件摧毁了地球表面的大部分生命。很快人们就发现，这些火焰是如此神奇地密集，以至于它们需要一千年才能自行死亡。乌祖和祖哈尔这两个大陆联合起来，让他们的世界恢复平衡。新一代的魔法师诞生了，特拉玛格斯的任务是治愈世界并给每个生物带来未来的希望。

米凯拉和雪春，两名地马吉新手，在完成训练后即将出发前往大陆的中心。随着他们世界的秘密慢慢揭开，他们的旅程将变得比他们想象的更加复杂。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617580/]Steam[/url]]
